keep_original.name: llm_strat_order_pending_enqueue
keep_original.reason: our body MASKS FIELDS IN PLACE through the record pointer (`in.unit_index &= 0xff` and three siblings, order_queue.cpp) before copying it into the pending array. The thunked call direction hides that -- the marshalling thunk hands the callee a private copy, which is why mh_calls.gen.h spells that direction `const` -- but a REBIND removes the thunk and calls the body directly, so binding this row to the const member would mask the CALLER's record. Evidenced at LIB-CONSTSIG 2026-09-04: the disassembly dig found the ORIGINAL read-only at the by-value level (true, and not the question), and the compiler found our translation writing through the pointer the moment the wrapper was made const. This is a real aliasing constraint, NOT the generator disagreement the item was opened for.
